subject: Quantitative Aptitude
topic: Mensuration 3D — Cylinder, Cone, Sphere and Cuboid (W9)

questions.stem: The volume of a cube with edge 5 cm is:
questions.explanation: D is correct. Volume of cube = a³ = 5³ = 125 cm³. The total surface area would be 6×25 = 150 cm² — a common distractor confusion.

questions.stem: Total surface area of a cube with edge 4 cm is:
questions.explanation: C is correct. TSA of cube = 6a² = 6×16 = 96 cm². (Lateral surface area = 4a² = 64 cm² — the most common wrong pick.)

questions.stem: The volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm is: (π = 22/7)
Volume of a cone with base radius 7 cm and height 12 cm is: (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: B is correct. V = (1/3) π r² h = (1/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 12 = (1/3) × 22 × 7 × 12 = (1/3) × 1848 = 616 cm³. Dividing by 3 at the end is the most common error (forgetting the 1/3 factor).

questions.stem: The slant height of a cone with base radius 5 cm and height 12 cm is:
questions.explanation: D is correct. l = √(r²+h²) = √(25+144) = √169 = 13 cm. Recognise 5-12-13 Pythagorean triple. The height (12) is the most common wrong pick.

questions.stem: The total surface area of a cone with radius 7 cm and slant height 10 cm is: (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: D is correct. TSA = π r(r+l) = (22/7) × 7 × (7+10) = 22 × 17 = 374 cm². The CSA alone = πrl = 22×10 = 220 cm² — a common wrong pick.

questions.stem: The volume of a sphere of radius 6 cm is: (in terms of π)
questions.explanation: C is correct. V = (4/3)π r³ = (4/3)π(216) = 288π cm³. The surface area = 4π r² = 144π — a deliberate distractor (option A).

questions.stem: A cuboid has volume 162 cm³. Its length, breadth and height are in ratio 3:2:1. Find the length.
questions.explanation: B is correct. Let dimensions = 3k, 2k, k. Volume = 6k³ = 162 → k³ = 27 → k = 3. Length = 3k = 9 cm.

questions.stem: A solid sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into small spheres each of radius 1 cm. How many small spheres are formed?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Volume of big sphere = (4/3)π(6³) = 288π. Volume of small sphere = (4/3)π(1³) = 4π/3. Count = 288π ÷ (4π/3) = 288π × 3/(4π) = 864/4 = 216.

questions.stem: The curved surface area of a hemisphere of radius 7 cm is: (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: B is correct. CSA of hemisphere = 2πr² = 2 × (22/7) × 49 = 2 × 22 × 7 = 308 cm². Total surface area (including flat face) = 3πr² = 462 cm² — a common wrong pick. The full sphere surface = 4πr² = 616 cm².
